title: Low and Wide
intro: Hips and groin, which is what tennis and padel punish most. Every wide ball, every open-stance forehand and every lunge to the net is an adductor at length under load.

This trains that range rather than hoping you have it when the ball arrives. The Cossack squat in the middle is the closest thing in a gym to a wide defensive ball, and it is the position a groin tears in if you are not strong there.

good: Knees wide, feet turned out, rock the hips back slowly
bad: Rocking back far enough that the lower back rounds

good: One leg out straight to the side, foot flat, rock back
Feel it down the inside of the straight leg
bad: Letting the straight leg's foot roll onto its edge

exercises.name: Cossack Squat
exercises.note: Go only as deep as you can come back up from without a wobble.

good: Wide stance, sit down over one leg with the other straight
bad: Dropping in and bouncing to get out

good: Step wide, sit into that hip, reach past the outside of the foot
Push back out through the heel
bad: Staying upright — the reach is what makes the hip work

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor with Overhead Reach

good: Squeeze the back glute, then reach the same-side arm overhead
Feel the front of the back hip, never the lower back
bad: Arching the lower back to feel more

good: Sit into the bottom of a squat, elbows inside the knees
Let it settle rather than fighting it
